93. Articles exposed to infection.—

—   (1) The Secretary shall, from time to time, notify 
places at which articles of clothing or bedding or other articles which have been exposed 
to infection from any dangerous or infectious disease may be washed or disinfected. 
(2) The Secretary may direct the destruction of clothing, bedding, or other articles 
likely to retain such infection. 
(3) Whoever washes such clothing or bedding or other articles at any place other than 
those set apart for such purposes under sub-section (1), shall, on conviction, be punished 
with fine which may extend to fifty rupees.
